programme.title: Hulk
programme.desc: Bruce Banner is a renowned scientist, with a murky family past, who suffers with his team a serious laboratory accident in which everyone is exposed to intense gamma radiation. When he discovers that he is the only one who has survived, he is confused and begins to investigate. But Bruce has developed a terrible ability after the accident that could hinder the investigation; when he gets angry he turns into a giant green monster with irrational and destructive behavior. To create the Hulk character using digital technology, the company Light & Magic made the largest technical deployment in its history. It was necessary to work together with one hundred and eighty ILM technicians and work on the character for more than a year and a half. Even so, there are viewers who have compared the technical quality of the Hulk to that of Shrek. In this film, Hulk reaches the largest size he had reached to date, nine meters tall. Ang Lee used the split-screen technique to cinematically imitate the panels of a comic book page. To do this, he had to shoot the same scene several times, which somewhat exhausted actor Eric Bana, who plays Brece Banner. Much of the microbiology work seen on screen is real, done by Ang Lee's wife.

programme.title: Red hot

After finding him, he discovers that he is a nine-year-old autistic boy with a prodigious ability to reveal supposedly insurmountable government codes.

programme.title: Spider-Man
programme.desc: Peter Parker is a shy young student. He has never had much confidence in himself and although he is very intelligent, except for his best friend, the rich Harry Osborn, he has no friends. He has been in love with his beautiful redhead neighbor for years: Mary Jane, but he would never find the courage to propose to her. Meanwhile, he lives in a small neighborhood in the New York borough of Queens with his Uncle Ben and Aunt May. His life will change forever when, during a visit to a laboratory, a radioactive spider bites him, causing changes in him that at first seem frightening but will soon make him feel as if he had spider superpowers: he has colossal strength, he can climb walls and ceilings and he can also create spider webs with his hands. With his new powers, Peter becomes more daring. He no longer needs glasses and has acquired muscles that make him very attractive. At school he saves Mary Jane from falling in the lunchroom and accidentally throws food at a bully named "Flash." When he is about to hit him, Peter manages to neutralize him and impresses his friends and the girl of his dreams. To try to win him over, she lies to her Uncle Ben by saying she is going to the library but actually entering a wrestling contest for $3,000. With the money he intends to buy a second-hand sports car for Mary Jane. But when he wins the fight he discovers that the manager does not intend to pay him. Snubbed, he goes out to the street to find his uncle dying on the ground: a thief has shot him to take the car. In his arms, the one who was like a father to him dies. Peter will now become "Spiderman" and use a costume to take revenge on criminals who destroy families like his. Soon his first enemy will appear: The Green Goblin. The Green Goblin was chosen as the villain of this film since director Sam Raimi felt that the father-son duel would make the film more interesting.

programme.title: Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: Two years ago Peter Parker decided to accept his responsibility as Spider-Man and put his personal life aside; within which enter his great love Mary Jane Watson and his friend Harry Osborn, who feels a desire for revenge against Spider-Man for the death of his father. Peter's relationship with both of them is increasingly deteriorating. Peter's friend and role model, Dr. Otto Octavius ​​begins experimenting with fusion energy funded by the current president of Oscorp, who is Harry Osborn. But accidentally, the experiment becomes unstable, so his robotic arms fuse to his spine and he loses control, becoming the villainous Dr. Octopus. Despite this conflict with Octavius, Peter faces the emotional distress caused by knowing that his love Mary Jane is engaged to another man. This makes him think about what his life would be like without having to fight crime, so he will be forced to choose between his personal life as a student and his public obligations. Directed by Sam Raimi, it is the second film in the Marvel superhero saga made by this director, who is also known for his low-budget horror films such as "The Evil Dead" trilogy. He also produced television series such as "Hercules: His Legendary Journeys" or "Xena: Warrior Princess." Tobey Maguire plays Peter Parker in this first Spider-Man trilogy, who made his film debut with "This Boy's Life" and starred in films such as "Pleasantville", "Seabiscuit" and "The Great Gatsby". Kirsten Dunst plays Mary Jane Watson. This actress, model and singer was recognized at the age of 12 for her portrayal of a vampire in "Interview with the Vampire." He also participated in "Jumanji", "The Virgin Suicides" by Sofia Coppola and "Marie Antoinette". James Franco plays Harry Osborn, who began in the series "Freaks & Geeks" and participated in films such as "Milk" or "127 Hours."

programme.title: Spider-Man 3
programme.desc: Peter Parker and Mary Jane are finally together. They have both been able to accept their feelings and start a relationship. Mary Jane has landed a great role on Broadway and Peter continues to put on the Spiderman suit, helping those in need and capturing the city's criminals. Life seems to smile at them, even though their friend Harry continues to blame Peter for his father's death. But this is not the only threat that looms over the protagonists. An alien entity with symbiotic and violent behavior has arrived on Earth. Peter comes into contact with it, but even though his powers seem to increase when it envelops him, Peter realizes the dangers it poses and gets rid of it. The alien possesses Eddie Brocks, giving rise to a new and feared villain called Venom. At the same time, another villain begins to operate in the city, Sandman. Finally, Venom and Sandman kidnap Mary Jane and Spiderman must save her with the help of an unexpected ally. Director Sam Raimi was against the appearance of the Venom character in his film due to the character's lack of humanity. But producer Avi Arad convinced him that he had a large group of followers who read his stories in the Spider-Man comics and that he should appear. Topher Grace's performance definitely convinced him of Venom's appearance in this third installment of the saga. It took three years to realize the special effects related to Sandman's powers, many experiments were carried out to analyze the behavior of the sand and digitally imitate it on the big screen.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: Peter Parker is a young man who studies in high school and lives with his Aunt May. But in addition to all the problems that a teenager his age can have, Peter's life hides something totally unusual, and that is that he combines his ordinary teenage life with the identity of the famous superhero Spider-Man. After having fought alongside the Avengers to save New York City, Peter returns to his Aunt May's house, where he will try to resume his routine while being trained by his mentor Tony Stark to become an Avenger and fight crime. The adaptation will not be easy and soon a new villain known as The Vulture will burst onto the scene, whom Spider-Man will have to defeat.

programme.title: Shark
programme.desc: Summer vacation has arrived in the small resort town of Amity Island. While the city council is in charge of making the place a wonderful and entertaining place for tourists, a great threat is approaching, endangering the safety of bathers. The police chief, Martin Brody (Roy Scheider), receives a tip about the disappearance of a young woman on one of the beaches. When they search the terrain, the young woman's dismembered body is found buried in the sand. The coroner's first resolution is that the girl was the victim of a shark attack. The police chief prepares to close access to the beaches but is intercepted by the Mayor. Brody argues with him until the coroner intervenes again and assures that his first conclusion was incorrect, and that the girl died in a terrible accident when she got caught in the propeller of some boat or ship. The police officer resigns and accepts the Mayor's "recommendation." A horde of tourists arrives on Amity Island that same day. While on Chief Brody's watch, a boy is killed by the shark and the truth becomes impossible to hide. A shark hunting specialist named Quin (Robert Shaw) offers his services in exchange for being the only one to receive the entire reward. Anyway, seeing the ferocity of the attacks, Brody asks for help from a marine biologist, Matt Hooper (Richard Dreyfuss), who identifies the shark attack as that of a white shark, one of the most dangerous. Quin, Brody and Hooper will try to hunt the feared animal together before someone else is hurt. The film's soundtrack is composed by John Williams, a highly successful composer who also created the soundtracks for the most renowned films by Steve Spielberg and George Lucas. Among them are those of "Schindler's List" and "Star Wars", in addition to the main theme of the "Harry Potter" saga. The film is based on a novel by writer Peter Benchley.

programme.title: The big shark (Jaws 3)
programme.desc: Third sequel born as a result of Spielberg's famous film "Jaws". When a baby white shark ends up trapped in a water park, the owner decides to use it as a lure to attract more customers. What is not expected is that the mother, an adult shark measuring more than 35 feet, will go looking for him and begins to kill bathers indiscriminately. Mike Brody, the adult son of Police Captain Brody, who killed a killer shark ten years ago, will try to take down the terrifying beast.

programme.title: When the river rises
programme.desc: The story takes place in Tennessee. Despite the threat of a rising river and a poor harvest, Tom Garvey and his wife Mae, a young farming couple, are determined to preserve the land of their ancestors. But, burdened by debt, Tom is forced to become a scab during a strike at the local steel mill, leaving his wife to run the farm. Upon their return, they have to face not only the flooding of a furious river that can wash away the work of so many years but also a power-hungry landowner who covets the lands of the Garveys and their neighbors to satisfy his ambition.

programme.title: No reservations
programme.desc: Kate Armstrong is a brilliant and demanding haute cuisine chef in charge of a famous restaurant. Her perfectionist and meticulous nature means that she does not accept criticism very well, which causes her boss to force her to go to therapy if she wants to continue maintaining her position as a chef. After the tragic death of her sister in a car accident, Kate is forced to take care of Zoe, her 9-year-old niece who has just been orphaned. Her new family situation causes Kate to face real problems reconciling her work day with taking care of Zoe, so her boss decides to give her a few days of vacation so she can adapt to the changes. After a few days of rest, Kate returns to work with more strength. However, upon her arrival the chef meets Nick Palmer, a chef who likes to take risks and bet on new ideas and who has been hired to replace her in her absence. The restaurant manager is delighted with Nick, so she decides to make him a permanent part of the staff, which will cause Kate to feel threatened. Rivalry will arise between both chefs due to their totally opposite characters and their different ways of working. Little by little, Kate and Nick will transform their rivalry into love, a process in which little Zoe will have a lot to do with.

programme.title: It happened in Manhattan
programme.desc: Marisa Ventura is a single, hard-working, intelligent and determined mother who dreams of achieving a better life. While working hard as a cleaner in a luxurious Manhattan hotel, her heart falls in love with Christopher Marshall, a rising politician who, upon seeing her, mistakes her for one of the hotel's high society guests.

programme.title: Apollo 13
programme.desc: In 1970, the Apollo 13 spacecraft makes one of many routine trips through space towards the Moon. Astronauts Jim Lovell, Fred Haise and Jack Swigert, who were supposed to fly on Apollo 14, are relegated to this mission that is unimportant in popular opinion. Everything changes when the ship is already outside the Earth, heading towards the Moon, and an explosion inside the space module threatens the entire crew. This is the mission that made famous the phrase 'Houston, we have a problem' and tells the story of how the astronauts did everything possible to survive, at the same time that, from Earth, NASA workers tried to plan a strategy to bring their men back home. To achieve true weightlessness, the cast and crew flew in NASA's KC-135 plane, nicknamed 'The Vomit Comet.' Some of the scenes in which the Earth can be seen from the windows of Apollo 13, the images of the planet are photographs taken by astronauts Jim Lovell and Bill Anders on the Apollo 8 mission. In the original recording of the real Apollo 13 mission, the phrase Lovell pronounces is not 'Houston, we have a problem', but rather 'Ahh, Houston, we have had a problem.' According to the director, Ron Howard, that phrase indicated that the problem had already passed, so he decided to change it to the present, so that the tension would not decrease. Actor Brad Pitt had the opportunity to participate in this film, but he turned down the job to play the protagonist of 'Seven'.

Much of the microbiology work seen on screen is real, done by Ang Lee's wife.

programme.title: back to the future
programme.desc: Marty McFly is a teenager tired of his family. One day he receives a call from his friend Doc, a scientist whom everyone thinks is crazy, to show him his latest invention. It is a time machine that consists of a car powered by plutonium. Marty accidentally activates the machine, traveling back in time to 1955. In the past, Marty discovers his teenage parents and mistakenly avoids their first date. Marty must reunite his parents, convince Doc that he comes from the future and manage to travel back to the present. Initially, the role of Marty McFly was going to be played by Eric Stoltz. However, in the middle of filming, the directors fired Stoltz when they considered that he was not the right actor. Michael J. Fox, who had been an early choice, was committed to the show Family Ties at the time. However, after Stoltz's dismissal he was available to record the film and immediately accepted the role. Christopher Lloyd plays Doc. Lloyd initially turned down the role, but ultimately accepted it once he read the script. The film's director, Robert Zemeckis, along with the screenwriter, Bob Gale, had already been interested in the idea of ​​making a film about time travel. The final idea came about after Gale reflected on the possibility of having become friends with his father if they had attended the same school. After Back to the Future, Robert Zemeckis directed other successful films such as Forrest Gump, Cast Away and Flight. The success of Back to the Future led to the production of a trilogy, as well as the creation of an animated series.

programme.title: Back to the future II
programme.desc: Marty, his girlfriend Jennifer and Doc travel to the future, to the year 2015, to prevent the couple's son from being imprisoned for a problem with the law. However, the presence of the temporary travelers will cause a bigger problem than the one they intended to fix and things will become increasingly complicated. The problem begins when Marty buys a sports almanac with all the results of the competitions up to the year 2000, in order to make easy money when he returns to the past. As in the first part, Marty McFly and Doc are played by Michael J. Fox and Christopher Lloyd, respectively. However, two of the actors from the first part, Crispin Glover and Claudia Wells, did not participate in the second part. Crispin Glover, who played Marty's father in the first part, was replaced by Jeffrey Weissman, who used facial prosthetics to look as much like Glover as possible. For her part, Elisabeth Shue was in charge of replacing Claudia Wells, who in the first part played Jennifer, Marty's girlfriend. Although the first film was not intended to have a sequel, the box office success motivated Robert Zemeckis to film two more films. After two years spent building the sets and writing the script, filming began in February 1989. Without a doubt, the biggest challenge was creating the futuristic vision of Hill Valley. It should be noted that this second part and the third part of the trilogy were filmed simultaneously.

programme.title: Back to the future III
programme.desc: Stranded in 1955, Marty receives a letter from his friend Doc telling him that he is in 1885 and that the time machine is broken and cannot be repaired. Doc isn't worried about being stuck in the past, saying he's happy working as a blacksmith. However, Marty discovers an old grave in which he reads that Doc died in 1885, and decides to go rescue his friend. Using the time machine Doc had hidden in 1955, Marty travels to the Wild West, where he discovers that his friend has run afoul of a gang of bullies and fallen in love with a teacher. Using technology from the time, Marty and Doc must find a way to return to the future. Since the second and third parts of the trilogy were filmed simultaneously, there are no significant changes in the cast with respect to Back to the Future II, with MartyMcFly and Doc once again played by Michael J. Fox and Christopher Lloyd, respectively. The most notable addition compared to the previous installments is that of Mary Steenburgen, playing Clara Clayton, the teacher with whom Doc falls in love in 1885. The idea of ​​traveling back in time to 1885 arose during the filming of the first film, when Robert Zemeckis asked J. Fox what historical period he would like to visit. Fox answered that it was the Wild West, and Zemeckis and Bob Gale decided to use this idea for the third part. Although the first film was not intended to have a sequel, the box office success motivated Robert Zemeckis to film two more films. After two years dedicated to building the sets and writing the script, filming of the second and third parts (they were filmed simultaneously) began in February 1989. Some scenes were filmed in Monument Valley. The train scenes were filmed at the Railtown 1987 State Historic Park, a historic train line located in Jamestown.

programme.title: the ghostbusters
programme.desc: Dr. Peter Venkman (Bill Murray) takes advantage of his research scholarship at the University to torture boys and conquer girls who take psychosensory tests. He is actually a very capable scientist who resorts to logic rather than superstition, but he uses the girls' gullibility to flirt with them. His friends, Dr. Raymond Stantz (Dan Aykroyd) and Dr. Egon Spengler (Harold Ramis), carry out ectoplasmic studies to investigate the possible existence of ghosts and even capture one for later study. The first time they have a warning about the real presence of a ghost in a library, they don't know how to deal with it and run away. It is after they are kicked out of the University that they decide to mortgage Stantz's house and start their own ghost hunting company. Over time they manage to develop machines that trap ectoplasmic beings for later study. But the jobs that come to the office are nonsense with what is about to fall on them. A young woman who lives alone begins to have truly shocking paranormal experiences in her home and decides to call the Ghostbusters to help her. The investigation will take them further than they ever thought they would go, seeing things they would never have dreamed of seeing. In Aykroyd's original script, the story took place in a future where there would be teams of ghostbusters like there are today of paramedics or firefighters. But the budget studied for that type of film amounted to three hundred million dollars and Aykroyd was forced to adapt it to the scientific reality of the eighties. Initially other actors were going to play some of the most important roles in the film: John Candy was going to be Louis Tully, John Belushi was going to be Dr. Peter Venkman, and the role of Winston was written specifically for Eddie Murphy.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: The Ghostbusters discover that New York is once again headed toward supernatural disaster, with a river of ectoplasmic matter running beneath the city and an old sorcerer attempting to take possession of a baby. to be born again.

programme.title: The President and Miss Wade
programme.desc: Andrew Shepherd (Michael Douglas), president of the United States and widower for just over a year, begins a romance with Sydney Wade (Annette Benning), a consultant for an important environmental organization. This relationship, in the middle of the election campaign, will be taken advantage of by Bob Rumson (Richard Dreyfuss), the opposing candidate, to attack the president.

programme.title: This house is a ruin
programme.desc: Anna (Shelley Long) is a young and attractive violinist who stays for a few days with her boyfriend, the lawyer Walter Fielding (Tom Hanks), in the luxurious apartment of her ex-husband, the great conductor Max Beissart (Alexander Godunov). They are happy, but they want to be even more so. Walter's formula is very simple, happiness is in a little house on the outskirts of New York with its white fence, a dog, two children and a little woman. But, at least for the moment, Anna's intentions do not involve marriage. However, the urgent need to look for a house is imposed when her ex-husband returns suddenly and needs to reoccupy her apartment. Walter turns to his friend Jack (Josh Mostel), a real estate agent, who provides him with a real bargain a few kilometers from New York, a dream house for very little money. After managing to raise the money, the couple buys the house from Estelle, its quirky owner (Maureen Stapleton). But unfortunately, mishaps begin to happen in this fabulous mansion: doorbells burn, the bed sinks, the door falls, steps break, ceilings fall apart, pipes shake and, as the final number, the staircase shatters. But since they still really like the house, with the best of their will they set out to fix the mess. They turn to the service of the unique Shirk brothers, Art (Joe Mantegna), the carpenter, and Brad (Carmine Caridi), the plumber.

programme.title: Absolute power
programme.desc: Luther, a specialist in grand thefts, plans to rob the mansion of a tycoon who is on vacation in the Caribbean. However, the victim's wife appears unexpectedly.

programme.title: the whole truth
programme.desc: Tom is accused of having murdered innocent civilians in El Salvador, fifteen years ago, in a secret military operation. His wife, Claire, is ready to discover the whole truth...

programme.title: The work
programme.desc: A 16-year-old boy's life is turned upside down when he involuntarily witnesses a Lebanese clan chief shooting an undercover LKA officer.

programme.title: When the river rises
programme.desc: The story takes place in Tennessee. Despite the threat of a rising river and a poor harvest, Tom Garvey and his wife Mae, a young farming couple, are determined to preserve the land of their ancestors. But, burdened by debt, Tom is forced to become a scab during a strike at the local steel mill, leaving his wife to run the farm. Upon their return, they have to face not only the flooding of a furious river that can wash away the work of so many years but also a power-hungry landowner who covets the lands of the Garveys and their neighbors to satisfy his ambition.

programme.title: Zooloco
programme.desc: The animals at Franklin Park Zoo adore their kind keeper, Griffin Keyes. When Griffin realizes that he is more comfortable with a lion than a lady, he decides that the only way to get a girl to share his life is to leave the zoo and look for a more glamorous job.

programme.title: 2 Guns
programme.desc: Robert Trench, an undercover DEA agent, takes advantage of gunman Michael Stigman's idea of ​​robbing a bank to get a mob boss out. However, the plan turns out to be exceedingly satisfactory when they get much more money than anticipated and, in addition, Trench's forces do not block their exit. To complicate things a little more. Stigman turns out to be a Navy Intelligence agent who shoots Trench and takes all the money. Soon, a confusing loop will begin in which both forces of the American army will pursue both Trench and Sitgman in a corrupt and dirty plot to each keep the profits. And without anyone expecting it, both Trench and Sitgman discover that they have to work together to be able to survive their own bosses and assault groups and to finally emerge victorious. During the development of the film, Vince Vaughn was going to play Bobby and Owen Wilson was going to play Stig. Also, as a curiosity, in the film's trailer you can hear the song "Die by the drop" from 2010 by the band The Dead Weathers. This song had previously been used in the trailer for Contraband (2012), which also featured Mark Wahlberg and was directed by Baltasar Kormákur.

programme.title: The mask of Zorro
programme.desc: 1821. The Mexican army strives to liberate its country from the Spanish yoke. In the Californias area, the evil Spanish governor, Don Rafael Montero, is about to lose everything. In a last attempt to catch his nemesis, the masked swordsman "Zorro", Montoro prepares to murder three innocents. With the help of two orphans, Joaquín and Alejandro Murrieta, Zorro frees the prisoners. Then he will give both boys a special medallion and flee on his horse, Tornado, after marking Montero with a small "Z" on his neck as a warning. But that same night the soldiers enter the house of a nobleman named Don Diego de la Vega and arrest him since they are convinced that he is the real Zorro. Don Diego's wife dies, he is locked up in prison and his daughter, Elena, is taken to Spain as Montoro's daughter, where he will raise her as if she were his own. Twenty years later, Montoro secretly returns to California and looks for Diego in prison but cannot find him because he is unrecognizable due to age. However, the prisoner does remember the man and with a thirst for revenge like he had never had before, he escapes from prison and decides to put an end to his enemy forever. Along the way he will discover Elena, his daughter, who is as beautiful as her mother when she was murdered. Tired, old and completely destroyed by the years of captivity, Don Diego de la Vega will decide to train an adult Alejandro Muerrieta, now a bandit and rogue, to become the new Zorro and avenge all the suffering that the evil Rafael Montero caused him. At first Anthony Hopkins rejected the role of Don Diego de la Vega because he had unbearable pain in his back. When a laser operation managed to alleviate the problem, he then offered to accept playing the wise old "Zorro."

programme.title: The legend of Zorro
programme.desc: 1850. California has been tortured by the colonizers for years but will finally become the thirty-first state of the Union. Zorro suspects that a group of individuals intend to sabotage this decision for their own benefit, so he will stop them in a heroic feat. At the same time, McGivens, a French baron, is dedicated to blackmailing the inhabitants of California to keep their lands and leaving those who earned their living from the countryside in absolute poverty. Don Alejandro de la Vega, the one nicknamed "Zorro" with his mask, his sword, his horse and his cape, has finally been able to marry the beautiful Elena and has a ten-year-old son named Joaquín. The little boy misses his father, whom he hardly sees, and on the other hand idealizes the figure of his hero, Zorro, without knowing what his true identity is. Alejandro promises to leave the mask behind forever and dedicate himself to his family, but when a new crisis appears in California, he acts once again to solve it. Elena, feeling cheated, kicks her husband out of the house and presents him with divorce papers. At that moment, an old companion of the woman arrives at the scene: the French aristocrat Army. When he finds out about Elena's separation, he immediately begins to court her while attending to his affairs in the secret brotherhood in which he is involved. Now Alejandro will have to choose between alleviating the suffering of the oppressed or returning to his family. But to do so he must defeat the always shady Baron Army. For "The Legend of Zorro" both Steven Spielberg and Robert Rodriguez planned to direct the film, but in the end they did not take the job, although Spielberg did stay on as executive producer.

programme.title: Siege status
programme.desc: Third collaboration between director Edward Zwick and Denzel Washington after "Glory Times (1989)" where he won his first Oscar for Best Supporting Actor and "In Honor of the Truth" (1996) and magnificent hand in hand full of tension between Denzel Washington and Bruce Willis. New York City becomes the target of a wave of terrorist attacks. FBI agent Anthony Hubbard (Denzel Washington) is appointed head of the joint anti-terrorist force and together with CIA agent Elise Kraft (Annette Bening), with important contacts in the Arab-American community, they will be in charge of arresting those responsible. Meanwhile, the government declares martial law and sends General William Deveraux (Bruce Willis) to command the troops in charge of occupying the city.

programme.title: Llamaradas
programme.desc: He was a child when he witnessed the death of his father in an act of service during a fire. Twenty years later, Brian is also a firefighter in Chicago. He is in a difficult trial period led by his brother Stephen who is very demanding of him. Both brothers will try to overcome disputes and memories of the past while an arsonist sets fires in the city.

programme.title: The Big Cases
programme.desc: The chilling story of Hull’s funeral home horror. How an undertaker drowning in debt betrayed hundreds of grieving families. Robert Bush hoarded bodies, sold fake funeral plans and presented families with the ashes of strangers. His shocking crimes went undetected for years. The discovery led to one of the most complex investigations in Humberside Police’s history, with help from the National Crime Agency. At the heart of this are grieving families. In their darkest days, they fought for laws to regulate the funeral industry so that others never suffer their pain - or guilt - again.

programme.title: The Climate Question
programme.desc: A global programme that reflects the variety of takes on climate change, how best to understand it and the world's attempts to avert it, temper it or adapt to it. It is not about questioning whether climate change is happening, it's about finding the best ways to respond to it. This is sharp-edged, analytical inquiry. Hard scrutiny, touched with a sense of adventure and discovery, and where we can find it, hope. It includes stories from across the world on why we find it so hard to save our own planet, and how we might change that.

programme.title: The Travel Show
programme.desc: The traditional French bistro is mounting a comeback. In recent times, an average of 25 a day have been shutting their doors, as eating habits change across France. Now though, efforts are underway to save them. Briony May Williams travels through the south of the country to find out what this casual form of dining has brought to French culture. She heads to a village that's finally about to reopen a bistro that it lost many years ago, and explores the rowdy breakfast culture of Lyon's Machon cafes.

programme.title: Talking Business
programme.desc: Can oil really save Venezuela’s economy? The country has the world’s largest reserves, so can it take advantage whilst global energy supplies are under pressure because of events in the Middle East? Reviving Venezuela’s biggest industry is just one part of the change that’s needed as the country recovers from deadly earthquakes and tries to restructure a mountain of debt after years of mismanagement. Respected former central bank president Ruth Krivoy and leading oil executive Ali Moshiri of Amos Global Energy give their takes on the role oil can play. Meanwhile, the president of Venezuela’s Chambers of Commerce and Industry, Felipe Capozzolo of Fedecamaras, explains some of the other reforms that could help the country become wealthy again.

programme.desc: Guntur berencana membeli sepeda ontel di toko Kr.Amat yang katanya bisa melaju secepat cahaya hanya dengan sekali kayuh. Terbukti ketika Guntur mengayuh pedal tiba-tiba sepeda itu melesat sangat kencang lalu lenyap dalam sekejap.

programme.title: Terdampar Di Pulau Kosong
programme.desc: Tomi mengajak teman-teman sekelas liburan di sebuah pulau.Tomi ajak Hani jalan-jalan dengan speedboat. Ditengah laut speedboat hilang kendali. Tomi menyelamatkan diri sendiri dan Hani ditinggal terdampar di pulau tak berpenghuni.

programme.title: Radio Kabar Buruk
programme.desc: Kisah seorang wartawan yang sering membuat marah atasannya karena lambat bekerja dan selalu ketinggalan berita. Setelah menemukan radio antik di Toko Kr. Amat, dia selalu mengetahui semua peristiwa-peristiwa penting

programme.title: Yuk Kita Sholat
programme.desc: Sally adalah idola kampus yang diperebutkan oleh Sam dan Sony. Sementara Sally hanya menyukai Bambang. Akhirnya Sam dan Sony meminta bantuan dukun untuk mengirim santet. hingga Bambang meninggal dunia.

programme.title: Bidadari Di Kebun Strawberry
programme.desc: Misi yang dijalankan seharusnya mudah, yaitu menaikkan penjualan strawberry, tapi ada saja yang menghalangi usahanya termasuk pria tampan yang tiba-tiba muncul.

programme.title: Tamu Tak Diundang
programme.desc: Zalwa dan Radit diperintahkan untuk mewawancarai seorang guru teladan di satu sekolah negeri. Walaupun dilarang Pak Wayan, Zalwa dan Radit tetap nekat menginap di rumah Pak Bima dan bertemu dengan hantu cantik.

programme.title: Kalau Lupa Jangan Cinta
programme.desc: Neneng, gadis desa yang lugu datang ke Jakarta untuk mencari Ujang, pacarnya. Neneng diajak tinggal di rumah Alfian tanpa sepengetahuan orang tuanya. Kegaduhan terjadi di rumah saat Nadya, pacar Alfian datang ke rumah Alfian.

programme.title: Kepentok Cinta Sementara
programme.desc: Arga diultimatum pihak kampus untuk melunasi biaya kuliah, Arga sama sekali tidak mempunyai uang. Beruntung ada Bonar yang bersedia meminjamkan uang, namun ada syaratnya yaitu, menjadi pacar sementara adiknya.

programme.title: Petaka Topi Pemikat
programme.desc: Annisa kehilangan nenek yang merawatnya sejak kecil, ia difitnah para tetangga yang menuduhnya menjual rujak beracun. Kehidupan Annisa berubah saat mendapat topi pancar pesona dari toko KR. Amat. Setelah itu keanehan pun terjadi.

programme.title: Amoy Aku Cinta Kamu
programme.desc: Key, gadis keturunan Tionghoa yang kabur dari rumah dan menjalin hubungan dengan seorang pria. Ketika sang kekasih meninggalkannya dalam keadaan hamil, Key bertemu Handoko yang mengenalkannya pada cinta tanpa syarat.

programme.title: Old Tv Terror
programme.desc: Teror yang diakibatkan oleh siaran berita di sebuah televisi tua. Setiap siaran berita tersebut memberitahukan peristiwa yang akan terjadi di masa depan. Meskipun sudah dibuang jauh-jauh, TV tua itu akan kembali lagi

programme.title: 7 Pusaka - Gasing Penghenti Waktu
programme.desc: Seorang penyanyi orkes melayu yang mulai kehilangan pamornya menemukan sebuah gasing bertuah yang dapat menghentikan waktu dan memakai kekuatan gasing itu untuk menghancurkan karier penyanyi baru saingannya yang cantik jelita.

programme.title: Cintaku Tak Seindah FTV
programme.desc: Ada tetangga baru yang bikin Alya kepincut dengan ketampanannya. Ramzi, cowok ganteng dan keren itu bikin Alya penasaran. Alya seorang penulis FTV, kerap menulis cerita percintaan. Apakah kisah nyatanya bakal seindah cerita FTV?

programme.title: Sepedas Cabe Kampus
programme.desc: Lilis berjualan cabe di pasar. Ia dijuluki cabe-cabean di kampus. Julukan ini membuat Ardian jadi mengurungkan niat untuk mendekatinya. Namun Lilis dan Ardian tetap saling jatuh cinta.

programme.title: Harta Karun Nenek Bajak
programme.desc: Putri mempunyai kekasih yang terlibat hutang bernama Draco. Saat sedang terdesak dia teringat bahwa dia memiliki kenalan bernama Mira yang memiliki nenek kaya raya bernama Nenek Bajak di kampungnya. Putri menipu Nenek Bajak.

programme.title: Punched by Love
programme.desc: Meskipun ibunya melarang, Indah tetap ingin menjadi seorang petinju. Saat sanggar tinju mengeluarkannya karena kesalahan pengisian data, Indah belajar kepada seorang rekan sesama petinju. Dan cinta tumbuh di antara mereka berdua.

programme.title: Punched by Love

Mr. Funnybone
programme.desc: Saksikan kelucuan Funny Bone saat ia berusaha memenangkan hati seorang wanita tangguh. Bersama dengan sahabat karibnya, Big Potato, seorang lelaki gagah yang selalu mengalami berbagai hal konyol.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: Tiga gadis pramuniaga cantik asal Hong Kong pergi ke utara untuk menyamar sebagai orang kaya dan mewujudkan impian mereka untuk menikahi pria kaya.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Seorang ahli bela diri licik mengincar para pendekar pedang muda berbakat. Ia menantang mereka dengan taruhan bahwa pihak yang kalah harus memotong lengannya sendiri, lalu mengalahkan mereka menggunakan jurus rahasia yang tak mampu mereka tangkis. Namun, salah satu korban terdahulunya memutuskan bahwa sudah saatnya menghentikan semua itu.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian adalah seorang selir Kaisar Tang yang berusia 14 tahun nan cantik dan berbakat. Ia menjadi biarawati usai sang kaisar meninggal, tapi ia memiliki dua putra dengan Kaisar Tang Gao Zong.

programme.title: Death Duel
programme.desc: Film seni bela diri yang spektakuler ini menampilkan Derek Yee dalam penampilan yang luar biasa, sebagai pendekar pedang Guru ke-Tiga, yang memerangi kejahatan dan menyelamatkan wanita yang mengalami kesulitan.

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Film komedi romantis yang dibintangi artis legendaris Lin Feng Jiao ini menceritakan kisah cinta yang tak biasa antara putra seorang pengusaha dan keponakan perempuan dari seorang kepala sekolah taman kanak-kanak.

programme.title: No doubt Charn
programme.desc: Berlatar di masa Dinasti Han, sekelompok orang yang dipimpin oleh Yang Chi-ching dan Lin Dai, berupaya untuk memisahkan sang gubernur dengan putranya dan akhirnya menyebabkan mereka saling memusuhi.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: Ling Yun berperan sebagai pemain pengganti yang disewa oleh sebuah band populer setelah pemain drum mereka yang egois mengundurkan diri untuk bergabung dengan band saingan mereka.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: Ling Yun berperan sebagai pemain pengganti yang disewa oleh sebuah band populer setelah pemain drum mereka yang egois mengundurkan diri untuk bergabung dengan band saingan mereka.

programme.title: Descendant Of The Sun
programme.desc: Seorang bayi matahari ajaib dikirim ke bumi oleh seorang dewa dan dibesarkan oleh seorang tukang kayu tua. Ia memiliki kemampuan bela diri nan luar biasa, yang akan lenyap akibat 'kripton hijau' saat gerhana matahari.

programme.title: Love Without End
programme.desc: Penyanyi Qing Qing dan arsitek Tang Peng Nan adalah pasangan serasi. Ia mengorbankan dirinya untuk membantu Peng Nan pada saat keluarganya mengalami kesulitan. Namun, mereka putus karena kesalahpahaman.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Mei Li muda bekerja sebagai pelayan bar di Wanchai untuk mencari nafkah. Ia jatuh cinta pada Jimmy saat bertemu dengannya di sana. Namun, Mei Li merasa sangat terpukul saat Jimmy harus pergi.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Ching Feng-Hsiao menyamar sebagai pria untuk mengikuti ujian sebagai pejabat sipil di kekaisaran demi menyelamatkan sang kekasih yang dijebak oleh ibu tirinya. Akankah ia berhasil?

programme.title: The Land Of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Biksu Tang San Zang, siluman kera, siluman babi, dan Sha Wu Jing berada di Womanland, tempat para wanita melahirkan bayi perempuan dengan meminum mata air ajaib.

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: Yen Chun menyutradarai dan membintangi film nan menyentuh yang berkisah tentang Chen, seorang gadis kecil yang dikirim oleh orangtuanya ke sebuah peternakan milik kerabat di suatu musim panas yang tak terlupakan.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Seorang pembunuh yang kecewa menerima satu serangan terakhir dengan harapan dapat menggunakan penghasilannya untuk mengembalikan penglihatan seorang penyanyi yang secara tidak sengaja dibutakannya.

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: Seorang bocah kaya yang terobsesi dengan seni bela diri bertemu pria misterius yang mengajarinya keterampilan bertarung, sehingga ia bisa memenangkan sebuah duel dan menikahi sang pujaan hati.

programme.title: The Dream Of The Red Chamber
programme.desc: Film yang diadaptasi dari novel Dinasti Ching nan populer, kisah cinta yang menyentuh ini terbukti menjadi tantangan bagi banyak sineas film. Kombinasi klasik dari sastra abad ke-18 dan pembuatan film tahun 1960-an.

programme.title: The Trail Of The Broken Blade
Between Tears And Smiles
programme.desc: Kwan Shan harus menyelamatkan wanita yang ia cintai, sebelum wanita itu dipersembahkan sebagai hadiah untuk seorang Jenderal!

programme.title: Love Without End
programme.desc: Penyanyi Qing Qing dan arsitek Tang Peng Nan adalah pasangan serasi. Ia mengorbankan dirinya untuk membantu Peng Nan pada saat keluarganya mengalami kesulitan. Namun, mereka putus karena kesalahpahaman.

programme.title: Apartment For Ladies
programme.desc: Betty Ting Pei berperan sebagai seorang penyanyi Taiwan yang datang ke Hong Kong untuk mencari adiknya yang hilang. Ia hampir diperkosa oleh geng jalanan dan diselamatkan oleh seorang komposer tampan.

programme.title: A Friend From Inner Space
programme.desc: Shek Kin, yang biasa berperan sebagai tokoh jahat, mengambil peran langka di film komedi tentang hantu lucu yang berteman dengan seorang anak lelaki dan membantu sang anak menyatukan kembali orangtuanya yang berseteru.

programme.title: Temple Of The Red Lotus
programme.desc: Seorang pemuda bepergian ke Lembah Naga untuk menemui sahabat masa kecil yang dijanjikan untuk menjadi calon istrinya. Sesampainya di sana, ia menyadari bahwa keluarga sang mempelai wanita menyembunyikan banyak hal.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah tentang pasukan tentara yang pergi untuk menghancurkan geng Hsien Lung, yang merupakan kelompok revolusioner anti-Yuan. Pemimpin mereka Ru Yi Tu melawan Fu Zhong Yuan, penerus kelompok Hsien Lung.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Berlatar pada malam penyerbuan Jepang di Hong Kong, film tentang kisah cinta yang tragis produksi Shaw Brothers ini dibintangi oleh Li Ting dan Kwan Shan sebagai sepasang kekasih yang terpisahkan oleh perang.

programme.title: Long Road To Gallantry
programme.desc: Pendekar pedang Tu Meng-Fei menyelamatkan seorang murid wanita, Mu Wan-Erh, dan gadis lainnya, Li Sai-Nan, dari pemimpin dunia kriminal Leng Tien-Lei. Li ingin membalas dendam pada Leng yang membunuh orangtuanya.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: Seorang wanita cantik nan bodoh diculik oleh alien, tapi tak ada yang mempercayainya. Saat berencana bunuh diri demi membuktikan dirinya, ia bertemu dengan seorang detektif gagal yang juga berencana untuk bunuh diri.

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Seorang polisi yang berdedikasi dihantui rasa bersalah karena telah menyelamatkan nyawa seorang pemimpin geng. Ia kemudian terobsesi untuk menghancurkan sindikat kejahatan yang dipimpin oleh pria yang pernah diselamatkannya.

programme.title: Challenge Of The Gamesters
programme.desc: Wong Jing menciptakan genre film perjudian hampir sendirian, dan dalam salah satu film laris awalnya, Shih Hsien memimpin pemeran bintang dalam kisah tentang mata-mata, taipan, dan gadis cantik.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: Seorang agen kekaisaran diejek karena berbagai penemuannya, hingga istrinya yang suportif mendorongnya untuk menghadiri sebuah konferensi, yang sebenarnya adalah jebakan untuk membunuh semua dokter yang melayani kaisar, di mana penemuan-penemuan gilanya menjadi berguna.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: Film ini berkisah tentang seorang pemadam kebakaran yang rela menerjang bahaya dan mempertaruhkan nyawanya demi menyelamatkan orang lain. Akan tetapi, apakah ia memiliki keberanian untuk menghadapi masalah pribadinya?

programme.title: Hail The Judge
programme.desc: Seorang hakim berusaha menyelamatkan seorang wanita tak bersalah yang secara keliru dituduh melakukan pembunuhan.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey: Pandora's Box
programme.desc: Raja Kera bereinkarnasi dalam wujud bukan manusia sebagai Joker, seorang perampok jalanan yang tidak menyadari identitas aslinya dan fakta bahwa 500 tahun sebelumnya, dia dan tuannya, Biksu Panjang Umur, dihukum dan dipaksa untuk tetap menjadi manusia.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Saat seorang pria meninggalkan istri dan putrinya, serangkaian percakapan singkat, gerakan yang diamati, pertemuan tak sengaja, dan tindakan impulsif, menceritakan kisah hubungan yang gagal dan berkembang setelah keputusan ini.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: Sun Chung dan Ti Lung bersatu kembali untuk sebuah kisah menegangkan tentang seorang pendekar tua yang berusaha menebus kesalahannya di masa lalu melalui seorang anak jalanan yang bijaksana.

programme.title: How To Choose A Royal Bride
programme.desc: Kaisar muda Kangxi sedang berusaha memilih seorang istri. Ibunya telah mengatur agar beberapa wanita muda yang tersedia mengunjunginya sehingga ia dapat memilih.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: Sebuah upaya pembunuhan yang gagal di Harbin, Cina pada tahun 1909 mengubah arah sejarah. Kini dua agen JBI harus menemukan hubungan antara benda tersebut dengan sebuah artefak Korea kuno.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: Stephen Chow berangkat ke kota besar untuk mencoba menyelamatkan rumahnya dengan memenangkan turnamen snooker besar.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Tn. Zhang diusir dari klannya setelah tahanan Chi melarikan diri di bawah pengawasannya. Lalu, Tn. Zhang datang ke sebuah lokasi tempat hilangnya sejumlah orang dan menemukan bahwa Chi lah yang menangkap mereka.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Long Wei mengalami gangguan pascatrauma usai kematian istrinya. Suatu hari, ia bertemu Amy yang bekerja di perusahaan teknologi VR dan diundang untuk menguji produk baru. Ia pun menjadi petarung VR perusahaan itu.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Valentino adalah penipu ulung yang bertemu dengan Kwan, sesama penipu. Bersama-sama, mereka menyamar sebagai berbagai orang dan menciptakan berbagai skema untuk menghasilkan uang. Sementara itu, para gangster sedang menyusun skema mereka sendiri.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey 2: Cinderella
programme.desc: Kelanjutan kisah penuh lika-liku dari Raja Kera yang kini telah menjadi manusia dan memiliki kemampuan menjelajah waktu. Dalam usahanya memenuhi takdir ilahinya, ia harus menghadapi berbagai tantangan dan pengorbanan di sepanjang perjalanannya.

programme.title: The Mask Of Shura Of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: Klan Black Feather nan jahat menyusup ke wilayah Master Fire Cloud dan mencuri Topeng Shura, sehingga melepaskan roh jahat nan masih bayi. Namun, Master Fire Cloud mengadopsi bayi itu untuk mencegahnya menjadi jahat.

programme.title: Iceman: The Time Traveler
programme.desc: Pengawal kekaisaran dan ketiga teman masa kecilnya yang berkhianat, yang diperintahkan untuk memburunya, secara tidak sengaja terkubur dan membeku dalam waktu. 400 tahun kemudian berlalu dan mereka dicairkan, melanjutkan pertempuran yang mereka tinggalkan.

Kehidupannya berubah drastis ketika seorang tamu wanita ditemukan tewas saat ia bertugas, membuatnya menjadi pusat penyelidikan polisi. Rain, wind and rising sea levels are a triple threat, but these extraordinary birds have begun to adapt to the new extremes by extending their breeding window and given those who lost their chicks a second chance - meanwhile, a sea otter mum faces a huge winter storm in California and a clownfish on the Great Barrier Reef witnesses her anemone home bleach. However, the clownfish is not ready to give up and sets about reviving it - perhaps most remarkable of all, though, is a little anole lizard that clings on for dear life during a hurricane, surviving as those with the longest toes are the species most able to keep their grip.

programme.title: Inside Iran: War & Revolution
programme.desc: Following unprecedented protests and a devastating military conflict, Iranian citizens are risking their lives to share what truly happened inside their country. The film features exclusive, on-the-ground footage and interviews with ordinary people, journalists, and grieving families - many speaking anonymously - who survived the brutal 2026 uprising and subsequent war. Through their detailed first-hand accounts, this documentary - for the BAFTA-winning ITV Exposure strand - explores how the Islamic Republic's ruthless crackdown on civilian demonstrations escalated into a terrifying international crisis. Their testimonies expose harrowing scenes of internet blackouts, state-sanctioned killings of unarmed protesters, and the devastating reality of life under US and Israeli bombardment. The film pieces together a rare, unfiltered picture from inside Iran - capturing a resilient population caught in the deadly crossfire of domestic authoritarianism and global warfare.

programme.title: Sharpe
programme.desc: Napoleonic War-based action-adventure. June 1813 - the South Essex is seriously short of men, and when the Duke of Wellington is told that there are no recruits available, he sends Sharpe to England to investigate. When Sharpe and Harper arrive, they are informed that there are 700 men waiting for them in Chelmsford - however, Sharpe finds the barracks deserted with no sign of his missing regiment. He and Harper decide to assume other identities and enlist - recruited by Sergeant Havercamp, Sharpe and Harper arrive at a training camp near the estate of Sir Henry Simmerson where they are trained mercilessly. Sharpe discovers that the new recruits are being auctioned to other regiments and returns to the Horse Guards with this information to entrust it to an old friend called Lawford... but Lawford wants to avoid a scandal and promptly tells Lord Fenner, who tries to have Sharpe killed. With the help of Fenner's mistress Lady Anne, Sharpe must now find the proof to implicate Fenner.

programme.title: Sharpe
programme.desc: Napoleonic War-based action-adventure. Winter 1813 - Wellington is informed by the debonair Comte de Maquerre that Bordeaux is ready to rebel against Napoleon, but Wellington's spymaster Ross is suspicious and tests Maquerre by suggesting that they use Maquerre's own castle as a base. Maquerre reluctantly agrees but says that the castle is in Napoleon's hands, so Wellington appoints Colonel Bampfylde to lead the attack on the castle with Sharpe in support. Bampfylde, who is intent on glory, sends Sharpe on a scouting mission and tries to capture the castle on his own, but he fails and casualties are heavy - Sharpe, who is a witness to the carnage, therefore has Harris and Frederickson sneak into the castle in disguise, and they soon force the French to surrender once inside. Ashamed by Sharpe's victory, Bampfylde sends him off on a reconnaissance mission - however, Sharpe soon discovers that Bordeaux has no intention of rising against Napoleon and that Maquerre is a double agent.

programme.title: Hi-Five
programme.desc: Hi-Five mengisahkan lima orang biasa yang hidupnya berubah setelah menerima transplantasi organ dari donor misterius yang sama. Tidak lama kemudian, mereka menyadari bahwa transplantasi tersebut memberikan kemampuan luar biasa yang berbeda-beda pada masing-masing orang. Saat masih berusaha memahami kekuatan baru mereka, muncul seorang pria berbahaya yang ingin menguasai kemampuan tersebut demi ambisinya sendiri. Terpaksa bersatu meskipun memiliki latar belakang dan kepribadian yang berbeda, kelima tokoh ini menjalani petualangan penuh aksi, humor, dan tantangan untuk menghadapi ancaman yang mengincar mereka. Dengan nuansa superhero khas Korea, film ini menghadirkan kisah seru tentang kerja sama, keberanian, dan persahabatan.
